statement: Over Z an independently marked multiweight PD-disk source is admissible iff it has exactly one generator of weight1 marked ±T
depends_on: Dold-Kan; p-digit divided-power decomposition; Tor and field Kunneth
notes: Rules out the entire free marked-disk globalization strategy, including infinite generator sets; does not refute general C3.

statement: No admissible independently marked disk source maps to the integral standard tail A_N for N>1
notes: A_N itself is a non-elementary source for (A_N,F); the full groupoid gate remains.
